# Projects experience review

Unmodified browser captures of the actual Space UI with fictional review data. No real workspace identities, credentials, repository contents or service writes are included.

- `manage-collapsed.png`: default project cards.
- `manage-expanded.png`: project details, contextual copying and Issues.
- `manage-issues-mobile.png`: expanded card and Issues at320px.
- `files-list.png`: Files List with an open file browser.
- `project-activity.png`: Inbox Activity scoped to a project.

Capture instructions and fixture safety are documented in `tests/space_ui_preview/README.md`.
